name: Growjo

sources.title: Growjo 'Add Your Company' — submission form for company data (content read via search result; site 403 to fetchers)
Growjo Join — 'It's Free! Currently there is no cost to join'; 'You must have an email address that matches the company to claim a profile' (content read via search result)
Growjo About — 'no submission necessary' rankings of companies with 15-1,000 employees; top-10K lists by growth metrics; free CSV exports (content read via search result)

requirements: Add-your-company form at growjo.com/add-your-company; submissions include revenue (past 12 months), employee counts (now vs 1 year ago), industry, keywords, funding
Claiming an existing profile requires an email on the company domain
Ranked lists (top-10K) only cover companies with 15-1,000 employees — tiny teams get a profile but not ranking
growjo.com blocked automated fetch (403) — verified via the site's own help pages
preparation: Growth metrics to submit: revenue, headcount now vs a year ago, funding, industry, keywords
workflow: Check if a profile already exists (Growjo scrapes data) — claim it with a domain-matching email
Otherwise submit via growjo.com/add-your-company with growth data
Profiles feed Growjo's fastest-growing lists; members can export CSVs free
watchFor: Data points requested (revenue, headcount) become public — only share what's comfortable
The ranking lists exclude sub-15-employee companies
Site claims 1M monthly visits — the real audience is data browsers, not product hunters
countsAsLive: The company has a public Growjo profile page
